status: declared before implementation, compilation or timing
mechanism: Private exact Crossbeam-deque0.8.8 patch retains old immutable buffer descriptors and payload arrays in the shared Inner until the final Arc owner/stealer drops. Retained queues only grow. Single and batch probes use an unprotected guard only when every accessed shared worker buffer is retained; preserve the SeqCst fence before back-load and every existing extraction/CAS/order operation. Mixed-mode batches use ordinary epoch protection if either queue is normal. Resizing still pins normally. Injector and Rayon scheduler unchanged.
ownership: Store retired descriptors as Atomic pointer handles, never Shared::into_owned while a stealer can hold a reference. Worker is not Sync; only its owner mutates the retired vector. Final Inner drop occurs after all owner/stealer Arc handles, drops pending tasks only in the current buffer, then deallocates every retired raw array without re-dropping copied tasks.
activation: Private cfg zopro_retained_deque_buffers plus explicit ZOPRO_CPU_RETAINED_DEQUE_BUFFERS=1 sampled once per process. Absent/0 OFF. Mode fixed per queue at construction. No production source/dependency changes; no registry mutation.
memory: Disable both FIFO and LIFO shrink sites in retained mode. Sum of prior geometrically increasing payload array capacities is less than current capacity, total arrays below2x high-water current plus O(log high-water) descriptors/Vec metadata. Retains high-water until final pool/stealer destruction, a real long-lived-pool tradeoff. No proving-key table or copied key points. Need measured actual queue sizes and later pressure/large/mobile qualification.
history: Different from prior empty-probe, batched epoch guards, finite victim search and St3 queue replacements; retain original extraction and scheduler logic. Prior negative results remain failed. No exact ownership design found in archived README/design audit.
safety_limit: Lifetime models cover descriptor/array retention and final handle destruction only. They do not verify the full scheduler or existing generic payload read/write protocol; source audit preserves that upstream protocol. Do not infer removable wall time from epoch CPU sample weights.
tests: Exact upstream Crossbeam tests both modes, custom FIFO/LIFO geometric bound, growth/shrink contrast, owner-before-stealer drop, payload exactly-once, concurrent resize/steal, all mixed modes/flavors/batch variants/limits, nested epoch protection. Properly instrumented Loom ownership/lifetime model with a premature-reclamation negative control. Exact upstream Rayon-core both modes plus overloaded/nested/FIFO/cross-pool/panic/reuse integration. Native core both modes and raw/cubic prover tests before SDK timing.

capacity_diagnostic.qualification: Observe actual payload size, high-water capacities and retained storage; not a whole-process RAM bound or pressure qualification.

validity: Freeze accepted170, private exact source/lock/licenses, compiler/helper, linked libraries/SDK, inputs/verifier/protocol and prior proof identities. Mandatory fixture/freshness validation. Independent Gnark each export. Complete SDK includes solving, randomness, proving, internal verification and serialization. No build/test/other owned CPU work overlaps latency. All latency precedes profiles. Preserve failures and all samples; no unchanged reroll.
if_positive: Resource, portable, concurrent SDK and large-circuit qualification before adoption. Any actual C7a follow-up requires a distinct frozen protocol after this result. No cloud resource for this local screen.
publish: Commit and push each completed experiment, including negative; polite factual report, raw perf/symbol streams local with hashes.
